raw_segments.text: It will have been seen that the Heidelberg ton of the sperm whale embraces the entire
length of the entire top of the head.
And since, as has been elsewhere set forth, the head embraces one-third of the whole length
of the creature, then setting that length down at 80 feet for a good-sized whale.
You have more than 26 feet for the depth of the ton, when it is lengthwise hoisted up
and down against a ship's side.
